title: Conquests and Moses’ Plea

questions.question: How many cities did Israel take from Og of Bashan?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 3:4 (ESV): "All his cities... sixty cities, the whole region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan."

questions.question: Which tribes received land east of the Jordan?
options: Reuben, Gad, and half of Manasseh
questions.correctAnswer: Reuben, Gad, and half of Manasseh
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 3:12–13 (ESV): "This land we took... I gave to the Reubenites and the Gadites... and the rest of Gilead... I gave to the half-tribe of Manasseh."

questions.question: What did Moses ask God to see?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 3:25 (ESV): "‘Please let me go over and see the good land beyond the Jordan, that good hill country and Lebanon.’"

questions.question: What was God’s response to Moses’ request?
options: He let Moses see it from Pisgah but not enter
questions.correctAnswer: He let Moses see it from Pisgah but not enter
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 3:27 (ESV): "‘Go up to the top of Pisgah and lift up your eyes... for you shall not go over this Jordan.’"

questions.question: Who did Moses charge to lead Israel into the land?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 3:28 (ESV): "But charge Joshua, and encourage and strengthen him, for he shall go over at the head of this people, and he shall put them in possession of the land that you shall see."

questions.question: What was Og’s bedstead made of?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 3:11 (ESV): "Behold, his bed was a bed of iron. Is it not in Rabbah of the Ammonites?"

questions.question: How big was Og's bedstead?
options: Nine cubits long and four cubits wide
questions.correctAnswer: Nine cubits long and four cubits wide
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 3:11 (ESV): "Nine cubits was its length, and four cubits its breadth, according to the common cubit."

questions.question: What cities were described as being fortified with high walls?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 3:5 (ESV): "All these were cities fortified with high walls, gates, and bars..."

questions.question: Where was the land of the Rephaim?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 3:13 (ESV): "(All that region of Argob, with all Bashan, is called the land of Rephaim.)"

questions.question: Until what point were the men of war from the two and a half tribes to stay with their brothers?
options: Until the Lord gives rest to your brothers
questions.correctAnswer: Until the Lord gives rest to your brothers
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 3:20 (ESV): "until the Lord gives rest to your brothers, as to you, and they also occupy the land..."

questions.question: What mountain was Hermon called by the Sidonians?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 3:9 (ESV): "(The Sidonians call Hermon Sirion, while the Amorites call it Senir.)"

questions.question: What mountain was Hermon called by the Amorites?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 3:9 (ESV): "(The Sidonians call Hermon Sirion, while the Amorites call it Senir.)"

questions.question: Who took the region of Argob and called it Havvoth-jair?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 3:14 (ESV): "Jair the Manassite took all the region of Argob... and called the villages after his own name Havvoth-jair..."

questions.question: Where were the Israelites staying when Moses spoke these things?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 3:29 (ESV): "So we remained in the valley opposite Beth-peor."

questions.question: Why was God angry with Moses?
options: On your account (because of the people)
questions.correctAnswer: On your account (because of the people)
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 3:26 (ESV): "But the Lord was angry with me on your account and would not listen to me."

key_verse_text: You shall not fear them, for it is the LORD your God who fights for you. (ESV)
